question: Under AsyncStorageWrites with ordered local workers, does an actual later-term vote request followed by old and then current append completions leave and then clear the follower unstable prefix, even when the current-term storage request contains no new entries?
rationale: Construct a single history through public RawNode methods using three actual raft instances. Bootstrap each Storage from the same term-1 committed snapshot, run a real term-2 election, then replicate a proposal to node 2 while delaying its append worker and withholding network messages to node 3. A real node-3 Campaign creates the higher-term vote request. Process node-2 append requests and all responses in original target order, observing unstable frontiers after each. MemoryStorage substitutes durable device I/O without crashes; this exploration answers producer/completion reachability and records actual effects, not a safety finding. Internal fields are read only. Deferred local work is drained at completion, with a finite driver bound.
